ast-grep.name: ast-grep
ast-grep.description: AST-based code search and replace using ast-grep. Provides pattern matching, code rewriting, and structural search across codebases.
gotchas: Pattern matching uses AST-based queries, not regex
Write patterns in const format for best results
Works best on TypeScript/JavaScript/Go/Rust code

code-sandbox.name: code-sandbox
code-sandbox.description: Isolated Node.js sandbox for running untrusted code. Provides safe execution environment for test scripts, build tools, and code generation.
gotchas: Sandbox has limited filesystem access by default
Network access may be restricted depending on configuration
Use for untrusted code only — not for performance-critical tasks

playwright.name: playwright
playwright.description: Browser automation via Playwright MCP. Provides screenshot capture, page navigation, console log inspection, and visual regression testing across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
gotchas: Browsers must be installed before first use
Headless mode by default — use --headed for visible browser
WebKit tests require macOS or Windows with proper dependencies

sequential-thinking.name: sequential-thinking
sequential-thinking.description: Structured reasoning and chain-of-thought orchestration via MCP. Provides step-by-step reasoning capabilities for complex problem solving.
gotchas: Chain length affects context consumption — keep chains focused
Each step should be a complete thought, not a fragment

fetch.name: fetch
fetch.description: Web content fetching and extraction via MCP. Provides HTTP GET/POST, HTML-to-text conversion, and structured content extraction from web pages.
gotchas: HTTPS required for most sites — HTTP may be blocked
Large pages may be truncated — use char limits
JavaScript-heavy sites may return empty content without rendering

filesystem.name: filesystem
filesystem.description: File system operations via MCP. Provides file read/write/create/delete, directory listing, search, and path manipulation across configured directories.
gotchas: Only configured directories are accessible — cannot escape sandbox
Write operations are permanent — no undo
Large files may consume significant context

github.name: github
github.description: GitHub API via MCP. Provides repository management, PR creation/review, issue tracking, code search, and GitHub Actions integration.
gotchas: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN must be set in environment
Token needs repo scope for private repos
Rate limits apply — 5000 requests/hour for authenticated users

memory.name: memory
memory.description: Persistent memory storage via MCP. Provides create/read/update/delete for structured memory entries that persist across agent sessions.
gotchas: Memory is stored locally — not shared across machines
Large memory stores can slow down search
Use structured keys for efficient retrieval

mcp-docker.name: mcp-docker
mcp-docker.description: Docker MCP gateway for managing containerized MCP services. Provides container lifecycle management, image operations, and Docker network control.
gotchas: Requires Docker daemon running
MCP gateway profile must be configured before use
Container networking may require additional setup

honcho.name: honcho
honcho.description: MCP gateway service for managing multiple MCP server connections. Provides centralized MCP server orchestration and session management.
prerequisites: Hermès configured with honcho MCP endpoint
gotchas: Requires online connection to honcho.dev
Bearer token authentication — token refresh may be needed

context7.name: context7
context7.description: Authoritative external documentation and API references via MCP. Provides version-specific library docs, release notes, and migration guides for informed decision-making.
gotchas: Use resolve-library-id before query-docs — never skip the resolution step
Max 3 resolve-library-id calls and 3 query-docs calls per question
Docs are helpful but not infallible — verify security-critical info

sentry.name: sentry
sentry.description: Sentry error tracking and issue management via MCP. Provides issue search, error aggregation, performance monitoring, and release tracking.
gotchas: Requires Sentry authentication with appropriate scope
Only works for projects you have access to
Rate limits on search queries

tavily.name: tavily
tavily.description: Web search via Tavily MCP. Provides researching queries, news search, and comprehensive web results with API key authentication.
gotchas: TAVILY_API_KEY must be set — server cannot connect without it
Rate limits apply — batch searches rather than firing many in parallel
Results are web pages — use fetch MCP server to extract content

parallel-search.name: parallel-search
parallel-search.description: Parallel web search across multiple queries simultaneously. Provides batched search execution for efficient research and discovery.
gotchas: Parallel requests consume more API quota — use judiciously
Results may be less relevant than focused single searches

parallel-task.name: parallel-task
parallel-task.description: Parallel task execution and coordination via MCP. Provides task distribution, result aggregation, and parallel workflow management.
gotchas: Task results must be collected after distribution
Failed tasks should be retried with backoff

smithery.name: smithery
smithery.description: MCP toolbox registry and tool discovery via Smithery. Provides MCP server discovery, toolbox search, and tool registration management.
gotchas: Requires Smithery authentication
Registry may include unverified servers — check before use
Tool discovery is async — results may lag behind registry updates

docs.name: docs
docs.description: Documentation generation and management via docs-mcp. Provides documentation extraction, formatting, and organization for codebases.
gotchas: Target directory must exist and be writable
Generated docs may need manual review for accuracy

postgres.name: postgres
postgres.description: PostgreSQL database access via MCP. Provides SQL query execution, schema inspection, connection management, and transaction control.
gotchas: DATABASE_URL must be set in environment
Connection pooling is handled by the MCP server
DDL statements are permanent — use transactions for safety

pytest.name: pytest
pytest.description: Python test execution via pytest-mcp. Provides test running, result reporting, and test suite management for Python projects.
gotchas: Target directory must contain Python tests
pytest configuration (pytest.ini, pyproject.toml) must be present
Test results are streamed — large suites may take time

django.name: django
django.description: Django ORM and application management via django-mcp. Provides model inspection, query execution, migration management, and Django settings access.
gotchas: DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE must be set — points to ecom backend by default
Database migrations are permanent — review before applying
Django version compatibility — check before upgrading

python-quality.name: python-quality
python-quality.description: Python code quality via ruff linting and pyright type checking. Provides static analysis, lint reporting, and type validation for Python codebases.
prerequisites: ruff and pyright installed in venv
gotchas: Runs against Python files only — not for JS/TS
pyright can be slow on large codebases
ruff rules can be configured via ruff.toml

tooling-lint.name: tooling-lint
tooling-lint.description: Multi-language linting via ESLint, Prettier, Markdownlint, and CSpell. Provides code style validation, formatting checks, and spell checking for JS/TS/Markdown.
gotchas: Applies to JS/TS/Markdown files only
ESLint config must be present (eslint.config.mjs or .eslintrc.js)
Prettier ignores unknown file types by default

tooling-config.name: tooling-config
tooling-config.description: Project configuration validation via pre-commit, git-cliff, and .gitignore checks. Provides configuration linting, convention validation, and git hygiene enforcement.
gotchas: pre-commit hooks must be installed (pre-commit install)
git-cliff config must be present (cliff.toml)
.gitignore should cover all generated files
